9

The Million dollar routine offers "Mark not complete"

waiting on you

WAITING ON YOU — approve or correct it

Where: the three dots on that one routine.

"whenever I press complete in the calendar I just don't want to see it in the calendar anymore - but I don't want it to come in a complete section within the setting, because routines and habits will never be complete unless I change the settings inside the edit."

2026-09-22, later "I'm referring to the million dollar routine — for some reason it looks like it's the only one where you click the three lines for the edit, it shows mark not complete instead of mark complete."

how I would solve it

Found it, and it is exactly one item — you were right. There are TWO ways to complete a task and they do not agree:

• the checkbox records that day — repeatDone: {"2026-09-22": true}, the routine itself untouched
• the three-dots menu does node.done = true, with no repeat check at all — marking the routine done forever

So completing the Million dollar routine from its menu did not finish that day, it finished the routine. That is why its menu now reads "Mark not complete" and no other item does. I would send the menu through the same per-day path, and clear the stuck flag on your existing item.
